idea-plugin.name: Ariada Accessibility
idea-plugin.description:
Ariada Accessibility scans the current project file for static accessibility findings and lists remediation guidance in an IDE tool window.

The initial build uses a deterministic local scanner boundary and performs no telemetry or external model calls.
idea-plugin.change-notes: Initial package skeleton with current-file scan action and findings tool window.

action.description: Scan the current file for accessibility findings
